# 工作包线与环境影响

_Operating Envelope & Environmental Effects_

发动机性能必须对应明确的环境、飞行状态和安装条件。先建立工况坐标，再讨论推力、油耗及部件限制；“全工况”也包含模型尚未覆盖或需要单独验证的区域。

_Performance needs defined environmental, flight and installation conditions. Establish the operating coordinates before comparing thrust, fuel consumption or limits, and identify regions requiring separate models or validation._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 把高度、马赫数、进口温度和压力，与发动机工作状态一并记录。

_Record altitude, Mach number, inlet temperature and pressure together with the engine operating state._

- 区分环境变化、安装损失与发动机自身退化，避免用一种修正解释所有变化。

_Distinguish environmental changes and installation losses from engine deterioration._

- 水、湿度和结冰等影响需要专门的试验与适用模型，不能由干空气理想循环直接替代。

_Water, humidity and icing effects require appropriate evidence and models rather than a dry-air ideal-cycle assumption._
